regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your charitable and generous favor of almost a month ago. I remember you and your pecu- liar case very well. I surely am pleased that things have adjusted themselves so well. God in His wisdom and mercy working so favor- ably in all. I hope too that your Husband has arrived back by now. Please pardon delay.
